prompt_md: In basketball's one-and-one, a player takes one free throw and gets a second only if the first goes in. A 60% shooter scores how many points on average?
prompt_short: One-and-one free throws, 60% shooter. Average points?
hint_md: The second shot only happens 60% of the time.
explain_intuition_md: Two shots at 60% each sounds like 1.2 points. But the second shot only exists when the first one goes in, so 40% of the time the trip ends with nothing.
